scope: Evidence-backed models, methods and evaluation for bounded decisions in AI systems.

sources.title: TypeSafe confidence semantics
sources.review_note: Current formulas and Noul field semantics reviewed. Distribution concentration is not a calibrated operational success rate.

sources.title: Laya Typed-Decisions model card
sources.review_note: Includes a released-checkpoint calibration warning; the Jev numbers are explicitly an external comparison.

sources.title: DeepSWE fixed-split projection head

sources.title: TabICLv2: A better, faster, scalable, and open tabular foundation model
sources.review_note: Version 2 dated 2026-09-16; listed as ICML 2026. Abstract and release metadata reviewed, not an independent benchmark audit.

sources.title: LLMRouter: Unified Infrastructure for Developing, Evaluating, and Deploying LLM Routers
sources.review_note: 2026-08-07 preprint; do not infer peer review from availability on arXiv.

sources.review_note: Gneiting and Raftery, JASA 2007. Publisher/index abstract reviewed.

sources.review_note: Guo et al., ICML 2017. Proceedings abstract/metadata reviewed.

sources.title: Selective Classification for Deep Neural Networks
sources.review_note: Geifman and El-Yaniv, 2017. Legacy image-classification setting is not an LLM deployment guarantee.

sources.title: Consistent Estimators for Learning to Defer to an Expert
sources.review_note: Mozannar and Sontag, ICML 2020.

sources.title: Conformal Risk Control
sources.review_note: First submitted 2022; reviewed version v4, 2025. Distinguish original monotonicity assumptions from later generalizations.

sources.title: Conformal Risk Control for Non-Monotonic Losses
sources.review_note: 2026-02-23 preprint. Stability-dependent guarantees are not universal per-decision guarantees.

sources.title: Proper Scoring Rules for Estimation and Forecast Evaluation
sources.review_note: Waghmare and Ziegel, Annual Review of Statistics and Its Application, 2026 volume; first online 2025. Abstract/index only.

sources.title: A Causal Target for Learning to Defer Under Hidden Confounding
sources.review_note: AAAI 2026 proceedings abstract. Adjacent research, not a ready-to-deploy router.

sources.title: Jev in the Wild: A Data-Driven Analysis of the Jev Model's Functionality, Applications and Ecosystem
sources.review_note: Jev application ecosystem survey; the abstract was reviewed, but project coding and results were not independently reproduced.

sources.title: Decision Index 0.2 release
sources.review_note: Methodology/release inspected; models and leaderboard were not rerun. Composite index is not raw accuracy.

sources.title: Decision-model benchmark
sources.review_note: Third-party repository/protocol reviewed; this list does not certify every artifact or headline result.

sources.title: OpenAI skill documentation
sources.review_note: Repository-scoped skills do not grant credentials, start schedules, or install themselves into this chat.

sources.title: jevos repository README
sources.review_note: Historical README submitted by project author feder-cr in PR #1. Its 0.815 / 2,000 comparison is author-reported, including the Jev 0.927 result; it is not a vendor-certified score or a result for the later v2 weights.

sources.title: jevos release (jevos-q4_k_m.gguf, jevos-q8_0.gguf)
sources.review_note: Historical release URL submitted in PR #1. It returned HTTP 404 at maintainer review on 2026-09-30; the submitted q4 hash 677d126a67d48a6ae965ce80973e7e68c7ab0b13b590a557d8f0cc29a178499f was not independently verified. Preserve this record; see the separate v2 release source.

sources.title: jevos pinned README and runtime documentation
sources.review_note: Reviewed README, LICENSE, CLI binary-mode selection, API translation/backend code, engine/engine.py, engine/prompts.py, engine/decisions.py, wiki/small-language-models-explained.md, wiki/measurements.md and wiki/llm-policy-decisions-put-the-rule-in-the-question.md. Documentation describes a 1B model; binary prompt compilation uses instructions and fixed 0/1 answer slots, with logits normalized to P(yes). Base-model provenance, layer count and training recipe were not established. This is source review, not runtime/SDK conformance testing.

sources.title: jevos-v2 release and asset metadata
sources.review_note: Published 2026-09-29 UTC. Release describes 0.795 on 999 hand-written questions versus 0.757 previously; author-reported, not directly comparable with the old 2,000-question README figure. GitHub API lists jevos-v2-q4_k_m.gguf (619289280 bytes, SHA-256 3cbf010ce06cba932af73346ee683ee98d375dc284c029967eb418472a4993f3) and q8_0. Asset metadata was inspected; binaries were not downloaded or hashed locally.

sources.title: Awesome Martech AI guide
sources.review_note: Companion maintained by the same repository owner. Reviewed five-layer scope, measurement/evidence standards, applied playbooks and synthetic incrementality-demo limits; navigation inclusion is not independent certification of its linked products.

sources.title: Cloudflare Clef launch and evaluation report
sources.review_note: Published 2026-10-01. Architecture, training description and benchmark table reviewed. Results are vendor-reported; no inference or raw-output audit performed.

sources.title: Clef 27B model card
sources.review_note: Pinned card describes the joint schema head, Jev/SystemOne wrapper and local encoder default. Repository revision pins reviewed text, not a verified weight hash or the hosted/evaluated deployment.

sources.title: Clef-Flash 9B model card
sources.review_note: Pinned card and configuration inspected; inference examples require the custom joint-schema implementation. No model weights downloaded or executed.

sources.title: Strands Decider repository
sources.review_note: Reference recipe v19; mechanism and local serving reviewed. Source commit is not an evaluated-weight identifier.

sources.title: Strands Decider architecture
sources.review_note: Pointer readout, confidence semantics and calibration inspected. For v19 teacher targets, the exact experiment config and results take precedence over the general training description.

sources.title: Strands Decider v19 experiment configuration
sources.review_note: Inspected configuration: rank-16 LoRA, frozen-torso KL and v14 replay on multi-step rows. The source was read, not executed.

sources.title: Strands Decider evaluation and limitations
sources.review_note: Author-reported limitations reviewed, including instruction sensitivity and confidence drift outside short classification.

sources.title: Strands Decider held-out choice probe results
sources.review_note: v19 first/last/not/irrelevant rows inspected. These are aggregate CSVs; underlying qsens_hobson-2b-v19.json, per-item predictions and actual sample count were not available in the checkout.

sources.title: Strands Decider question-sensitivity protocol
sources.review_note: Read probe construction and aggregation without executing code. research/scripts/collect.py confirms the CSV uses the held-out choice slice (emotion and massive_intent). Default sampling is not proof of the recorded run denominator.

sources.title: Strands Decider experiment record
sources.review_note: Records five promotions despite missed preregistered bars (v13/v14/v16/v17/v18); v19 met its four predictions. Also read v19-seed1 preregistration: stopped at step 1,420 on 2026-09-28, no results taken.

sources.title: Strands Decider original and AWS retrain results
sources.review_note: Original research v19 and AWS retrain are separate runs. No historical probe score is assigned to the published adapter by name alone.

sources.title: Strands Decider published v19 adapter card
sources.review_note: Published adapter/head card and LICENSE.md inspected. This release is distinguished from the original research v19 run; no weight bytes were downloaded or independently hashed.

sources.title: Strands Decider published adapter provenance
sources.review_note: Publisher identifies AWS run v19-p5-run1. Its base revision is explicitly inferred rather than training-time pinned; repository revision and author-supplied provenance are not independently verified weight bytes.

sources.title: Kev 1.0 release baseline
sources.review_note: Released 2026-10-01; explicitly introduces no newly trained checkpoint. Reviewed context validation, calibration, v2 regressions and release provenance; source pin is not a weight hash.

sources.title: Kev-27B v2 model card
sources.review_note: Relevant source text reviewed; no model execution or weight-byte verification.

sources.title: Strands Decider v21 release and same-host seed results
sources.review_note: v21 release seed, six-seed selection rule and separate same-host v19/v21b comparison inspected. Historical v19 evidence remains separate; no raw-output replay.

sources.title: Strands Decider released v21b recipe
sources.review_note: Relevant source text reviewed; no model execution or weight-byte verification.

sources.title: Laya documented operational limitations
sources.review_note: Read the current documented label sensitivity, negation examples and unusable act_probability warning. These include previously reported problems, not newly discovered defects or tests run here.

sources.title: Clef Workers AI interface and context limit
sources.review_note: Hosted context is 65,536 tokens; local encode_record default is a separate setting. Interface schema reviewed, not called.

sources.review_note: Card, file listing and API evaluation boundary inspected. The card history link identifies commit 5117a6c7fe73b19308dc1a6b0fb529a40c2ecad4, but the immutable body could not be fetched; this record retains the reviewed live URL rather than claiming a verified source pin. Training data and raw calibration/evaluation artifacts were not established.

sources.title: Perplexity local inference wrapper
sources.review_note: Read only: custom autojev runtime, choice/noul/score and image input, saved-temperature inference. No dependencies installed and no model code executed.

sources.title: Perplexity released decision configuration
sources.review_note: Saved temperature 2.207568021892729 and author-supplied run/data/code hashes inspected; hashes alone do not supply the underlying training or calibration datasets.

entries.name: Jev / TypeSafe

summary.en: Hosted typed judgments: probabilities over supplied choices, propositions and ordinal rubrics.
summary.zh: 托管的结构化判断服务：对选项、命题与有序评分标准输出分布。

use.en: A managed comparator when testing whether a judgment node is useful.
use.zh: 验证判断节点价值时，可作为无需自建部署的对照。

caveat.en: RLCD is vendor-described; the full training recipe is not public. Valid schemas and confidence fields do not establish semantic reliability.
caveat.zh: RLCD 的完整训练配方未公开；格式合法与置信度字段不等于语义可靠。

mechanism.en: Proprietary model. Choice/Score confidence summarizes the returned distribution; it is not a separate probability-of-correctness estimate. Noul returns P(yes) with no separate confidence field.
mechanism.zh: 专有模型。Choice／Score 的 confidence 是返回分布的统计量，并非独立预测的正确概率；Noul 返回 P(yes)，没有单独 confidence 字段。

training.en: Vendor-described RLCD; controlled independent ablations not established here.
training.zh: 官方称采用 RLCD；本版未取得受控独立消融证据。

availability.en: Hosted API; no public weights verified.
availability.zh: 托管 API；本版未核实公开权重。

entries.license_note: Commercial service terms; no open-weight license implied.

scale.en: Not publicly established by the reviewed material.
scale.zh: 核对的公开资料未明确参数规模。

entries.name: Laya

summary.en: Compact encoder family with dynamic option heads; general, multilingual and workflow-specialized checkpoints.
summary.zh: 小型编码器与动态选项判断头；包含通用、多语言及工作流专项检查点。

use.en: Narrow, high-volume judgments with domain training and measured hardware costs.
use.zh: 适合有领域训练数据、需要控制高频调用成本的窄域判断。

caveat.en: Do not mix base/specialist scores; the typed card discloses training/calibration overlap and inherited-temperature conflicts. Boolean labels can dominate noul/choice; semantic labels alone do not make negation safe. action.act_probability is documented as nearly constant at 1 and unsuitable as an execution gate. Validate confidence on your workload instead.
caveat.zh: 不可混用基础版／专项版成绩；专项卡披露训练／校准重叠和继承温度冲突。布尔标签可能主导 noul／choice；语义标签也不能保证否定句安全。官方称 action.act_probability 几乎恒为 1，不适合作为执行门槛；confidence 也需在实际任务上验证。

mechanism.en: Bidirectional encoder plus option-conditioned decision head.
mechanism.zh: 双向编码器加选项条件化判断头。

training.en: Proper-score rewards and policy gradients; the typed specialist also uses soft cross-entropy. Not a confirmed reproduction of Jev training.
training.zh: 适当评分奖励与策略梯度；专项训练还使用软交叉熵。不是已确认的 Jev 训练复现。

availability.en: Local weights/runtime; checkpoint and language must be selected explicitly.
availability.zh: 本地权重与运行库；应明确检查点及语言。

entries.license_note: Reviewed family/specialist cards declare Apache-2.0; verify each selected artifact.

scale.en: English and workflow specialist: about 421M; multilingual: about 322M.
scale.zh: 英语及专项版约 421M；多语言版约 322M。

entries.name: Kev

summary.en: Qwen-based typed decision family with a dynamic pointer head; Kev 1.0 freezes existing checkpoints as a release baseline.
summary.zh: Qwen 骨干与动态 pointer head 的类型化判断系列；Kev 1.0 将现有检查点固定为发布基线。

use.en: An inspectable starting point for domain-supervised decision models.
use.zh: 可检查、可微调的领域监督判断实验底座。

caveat.en: Keep trained-family tests separate from transfer. 27B v2 is worse and overconfident on long contracts (CUAD ECE 0.053 versus v1 0.007). Serving capacity and fitted temperature do not guarantee accuracy or calibration on new workloads.
caveat.zh: 须区分训练任务族测试与迁移测试。27B v2 在长合同上退步且过度自信（CUAD ECE 0.053，v1 为 0.007）；可接收长度和拟合温度不保证新任务的准确率或校准。

mechanism.en: Dynamic option readout on a language-model backbone; several model sizes.
mechanism.zh: 在语言模型骨干上动态读出选项分数；提供多个规模。

training.en: 0.8B/4B/9B use LoRA plus a head. 27B v2 fully fine-tunes Qwen3.8-27B, then averages weights 0.85/0.15 with v1. Temperature fitting is distribution-specific; 0.8B/4B use held-out items from trained families.
training.zh: 0.8B／4B／9B 使用 LoRA 与判断头；27B v2 全参数微调 Qwen3.8-27B，再按 0.85／0.15 与 v1 平均权重。温度拟合依赖分布；0.8B／4B 使用训练任务族的保留样本。

availability.en: Small releases require the base plus adapter/head; 27B v2 ships about 51 GB of full bf16 weights plus head. Served limit: 65,536 tokens. Author-validated CUAD context: 8,192 for 0.8B/4B/9B, 65,536 for 27B, under the stated 3-pp non-inferiority rule.
availability.zh: 小型号需基座、适配器与判断头；27B v2 发布约 51 GB 的完整 bf16 权重与判断头。服务上限 65,536 token；按作者 CUAD 的 3 个百分点非劣效规则，0.8B／4B／9B 仅验证至 8,192，27B 至 65,536。

entries.license_note: Kev 1.0 cards declare Apache-2.0 for the released weights/head and listed bases; verify the exact artifact. A family entry has no single weight revision.

scale.en: Released family spans 0.8B, 4B, 9B and 27B; inspect the exact backbone/card.
scale.zh: 公开系列覆盖 0.8B、4B、9B、27B；须核对具体骨干与模型卡。

entries.name: Contrastive Language Models (CLM)

summary.en: Separate state and action representations with learned projection heads on a frozen language-model encoder.
summary.zh: 冻结语言模型编码器，分别表示状态与动作，再用可训练投影头匹配。

use.en: Reusable candidate catalogs, tool selection and domain-trained Best-of-N selection.
use.zh: 适合候选可复用的工具目录、排序及领域 Best-of-N 选择。

caveat.en: Relative ranking cannot detect every all-wrong candidate set. Best-of-N scores include supplied candidates, not autonomous task-solving ability.
caveat.zh: 相对排序不能保证识别“全部候选都错”；Best-of-N 成绩不代表模型独立解题能力。

mechanism.en: Dual encoding permits candidate caching; released base uses frozen Qwen3-8B.
mechanism.zh: 双侧编码允许缓存候选；发布的基础版使用冻结 Qwen3-8B。

training.en: Contrastive InfoNCE with negatives; specialized heads require their own evidence.
training.zh: 含负例的 InfoNCE 对比学习；专项投影头需单独评测。

availability.en: Local code and weights; backbone still runs at inference.
availability.zh: 公开代码与权重；推理仍需运行骨干。

entries.license_note: Base card: Apache-2.0. Reviewed DeepSWE head card: MIT. Do not assign one license to the whole family.

scale.en: 8B base encoder plus learned heads in the reviewed release.
scale.zh: 本版核对的发布使用 8B 骨干及可训练投影头。

entries.name: Bespoke Nimble

summary.en: Qwen-based supervised adapter that reads answer-label logits instead of generating an explanation.
summary.zh: Qwen 监督适配器，直接读取答案标签 logits，而非生成解释。

use.en: A transparent baseline for evidence-sensitive judgments and minimal-edit training examples.
use.zh: 适合证据敏感的判断，也可借鉴最小差异训练样本。

caveat.en: Contrastive data construction is not CLM-style contrastive embedding training. Public benchmark reporting is author-run and raw run outputs are not all committed.
caveat.zh: 对比式样本构造不等于 CLM 的对比表示训练；公开比较由项目方运行，完整逐行输出并未全部提交。

mechanism.en: Qwen3.5-9B plus LoRA, scoring allowed answer tokens.
mechanism.zh: Qwen3.5-9B 加 LoRA，对允许的答案 token 评分。

training.en: Supervised learning; minimal changes to decisive evidence help define the boundary.
training.zh: 监督学习；用决定性证据的最小变化构造判断边界。

availability.en: Adapter and code are public; load the base model as well.
availability.zh: 公开适配器与代码；仍需加载基础模型。

entries.license_note: Reviewed model card declares Apache-2.0; inherited dependencies retain their terms.

scale.en: 9B backbone plus adapter; adapter bytes alone are not required memory.
scale.zh: 9B 骨干加适配器；适配器文件大小不等于所需内存。

entries.name: GLiNER2.5-Decide

summary.en: Schema-conditioned local classification with runtime labels and multiple decision heads.
summary.zh: 通过运行时标签与多个判断头实现模式条件化的本地分类。

use.en: Compact operational classification; inspect the runtime for supported cross-field constraints.
use.zh: 适合轻量业务分类；跨字段约束需核对具体运行库支持。

caveat.en: This review inspected the 1B card, which cross-reports 340M results. Dataset audit is incomplete; JevK5 in that table is not TypeSafe Jev.
caveat.zh: 本版核对的是 1B 模型卡，其中交叉报告 340M 成绩；数据集审计未完成，表中 JevK5 不是 TypeSafe Jev。

mechanism.en: Encoder-style classification; single-label and multilabel outputs.
mechanism.zh: 编码器式分类；支持单标签与多标签输出。

training.en: Treat checkpoint-specific training details as documented, not inferred from sibling models.
training.zh: 训练细节按具体检查点文档记录，不从同系列模型推断。

availability.en: Published local checkpoints and GLiNER2 runtime; use version-matched examples.
availability.zh: 公开本地检查点及 GLiNER2 运行库；示例须匹配版本。

entries.license_note: Reviewed 1B card declares Apache-2.0; other checkpoints need separate checks.

scale.en: 1B card directly reviewed; 340M and 287M sibling results/links are cross-reported there.
scale.zh: 直接核对 1B 卡；340M 与 287M 同系列资料由该卡交叉报告。

entries.name: GLiClass

summary.en: Label-conditioned text classification with user-supplied labels, including multilabel tasks.
summary.zh: 以用户提供的标签为条件进行文本分类，包含多标签任务。

use.en: An adjacent baseline for dynamic intent and label classification.
use.zh: 动态意图与标签分类的重要相邻基线。

caveat.en: Classification capability does not establish general workflow verification or calibrated operational risk.
caveat.zh: 分类能力不等于通用工作流验收能力，也不保证业务风险已校准。

mechanism.en: Joint text/label representation and label scoring.
mechanism.zh: 联合表示文本与标签，再对标签评分。

training.en: Consult the selected checkpoint; do not attribute every GLiClass variant one recipe.
training.zh: 以具体检查点为准，不给所有版本统一指定训练配方。

availability.en: Open repository with links to model checkpoints.
availability.zh: 公开仓库，并链接模型检查点。

entries.license_note: Consult repository and chosen checkpoint license; not fully audited in this edition.

scale.en: Checkpoint-dependent; no single family-wide parameter claim made here.
scale.zh: 依具体检查点而定；本版不为整个系列指定单一参数量。

entries.name: jevos

summary.en: Local yes/no decision model served as GGUF through llama.cpp, with a TypeSafe Jev-compatible request/response shape for `noul` questions.
summary.zh: 通过 llama.cpp 以 GGUF 格式提供本地是非判断，`noul` 请求与响应采用 TypeSafe Jev 的接口格式。

use.en: Experiment with CPU-local reading and triage questions; put the full policy in `instructions` and validate behavior on your own labeled cases.
use.zh: 用于探索 CPU 本地文本判读与分流；将完整规则写入 `instructions`，并用自己的标注样例验证行为。

caveat.en: Yes/no only: `choice` and `score` return 422, and the jevos documentation says `criteria` is accepted but ignored. Wire-format compatibility is not semantic equivalence. Arithmetic/date errors and benchmark sensitivity are author-reported; old README results do not identify v2 performance.
caveat.zh: 仅支持是非判断：`choice`、`score` 返回 422，jevos 文档说明 `criteria` 虽被接受却不参与判断。接口格式兼容不等于语义等价。算术、日期错误及评测敏感性由作者自报；旧版 README 的成绩不能代表 v2。

mechanism.en: The inspected binary runtime reads logits at fixed 0/1 answer-token slots and applies softmax to return P(yes), without text generation. The submitted MiniCPM5 base and 17-layer count remain unestablished; this code path was not executed here.
mechanism.zh: 核读源码的二元模式读取固定 0/1 答案 token 槽的 logits，再通过 softmax 返回 P(yes)，不生成文本。投稿所述 MiniCPM5 基座和 17 层结构仍未确证；本次没有执行这条代码路径。

training.en: Training recipe, dataset and base-checkpoint provenance were not established by the reviewed sources; no independent training reproduction.
training.zh: 核读来源未确证训练配方、数据集和基座检查点来源；没有独立训练复现。

availability.en: The v2 release lists q4_k_m (619,289,280 bytes) and q8_0 GGUF assets. Documentation describes offline CPU use via llama.cpp. Listed hashes are publisher/API metadata, not local binary verification.
availability.zh: v2 发布页列出 q4_k_m（619,289,280 字节）和 q8_0 GGUF 权重，文档说明可通过 llama.cpp 在 CPU 上离线运行。记录的哈希来自发布方/API 元数据，未经本地下载核验。

entries.license_note: Repository LICENSE is MIT; reviewed release metadata does not separately establish base-weight license provenance.

scale.en: Project documentation describes 1B parameters; this review did not inspect the weight tensors or independently count parameters.
scale.zh: 项目文档称为 1B 参数；本次没有检查权重张量或独立核算参数量。

entries.name: Clef / Clef-Flash

summary.en: Multimodal Qwen backbones with a joint schema head for typed decisions and a Jev/SystemOne-compatible wrapper.
summary.zh: 多模态 Qwen 骨干加联合 schema 判断头，输出类型化决策，提供 Jev/SystemOne 兼容封装。

use.en: Compare text/image-based classification, triage and ordinal judgments with task-specific error costs.
use.zh: 比较文本／图像分类、分流与有序评分，并按具体任务衡量错误成本。

caveat.en: Vendor benchmarks have task-specific trade-offs. API compatibility and probability outputs do not establish calibrated business risk; local inference needs the custom schema runtime.
caveat.zh: 厂商评测存在任务间取舍；接口兼容和概率输出不等于业务风险已校准，本地推理需要定制 schema 运行代码。

mechanism.en: Joint transformer head routes state evidence to questions and jointly scores their allowed options in one forward pass; no free-form answer generation.
mechanism.zh: 联合 Transformer 判断头把状态证据路由到问题，在一次前向计算中对各题允许的选项评分，不生成自由文本答案。

training.en: Cloudflare reports rank-256 LoRA plus the routing head, label-smoothed cross-entropy, Brier loss and a secondary RLCD objective on internal synthetic data; the full data/recipe was not audited.
training.zh: Cloudflare 称使用 rank-256 LoRA 与路由头、标签平滑交叉熵、Brier 损失及辅助 RLCD 目标，训练数据为内部合成数据；完整数据和配方未审计。

availability.en: Public weights and custom load_release_model/systemone helpers; also Workers AI. The hosted Clef page lists 65,536 tokens, while local encode_record defaults to 16,384. Check the specific endpoint schema for supported media and truncation.
availability.zh: 公开权重及定制 load_release_model／systemone 函数，另有 Workers AI。Clef 托管页面列 65,536 token，本地 encode_record 默认 16,384；媒体支持与截断行为须核对具体接口。

entries.license_note: Both reviewed release cards declare Apache-2.0; this does not establish that all training data or the full training recipe are public.

scale.en: Cards describe Clef as 27B (Qwen3.8-27B) and Clef-Flash as 9B (Qwen3.5-9B), each retaining a vision encoder; parameter counts are source-reported.
scale.zh: 模型卡称 Clef 为 27B（Qwen3.8-27B），Clef-Flash 为 9B（Qwen3.5-9B），均保留视觉编码器；参数量为来源自报。

entries.name: Strands Decider

summary.en: Qwen-based pointer-head decision model with rank-16 LoRA, typed outputs and a documented experiment history.
summary.zh: 基于 Qwen、pointer head 和 rank-16 LoRA 的类型化判断模型，公开实验演进记录。

use.en: A local baseline for short classification and domain-supervised decisions; test question changes, option order and risk–coverage on your own traffic.
use.zh: 可作为短文本分类和领域监督判断的本地基线；用实际流量测试问题变化、选项顺序和风险—覆盖率。

caveat.en: Same-host multi-seed evidence does not establish higher JevBench accuracy than the v19 recipe, although mean Brier is lower. Historical v19 instruction-sensitivity probes and short-classification confidence bands are not v21 guarantees; calibrate on the target workload.
caveat.zh: 同机多种子证据未确立 JevBench 准确率超过 v19 配方，虽平均 Brier 更低。旧 v19 的指令敏感性探针和短分类置信分段不能当作 v21 保证；需在目标任务上校准。

mechanism.en: Replaces the language-model head with a dynamic pointer readout comparing the answer-position state to option-token states; one forward pass for noul, choice or score. Confidence is derived from the distribution, not a separate correctness predictor.
mechanism.zh: 以动态 pointer 读出替代语言模型输出头，比较答案位置与选项 token 的隐状态，一次前向计算支持 noul、choice、score。置信度由分布推导，并非独立正确率预测器。

training.en: Current hobson-v21 is research v21b: v19 recipe plus checked question paraphrases and Qwen3.5-4B distillation where teacher and gold agree; no catch-all rows or instruction flips. Rank-16 LoRA and pointer head, with per-primitive calibration.
training.zh: 当前 hobson-v21 对应研究 v21b：v19 配方加核查过的问题改写，以及教师与金标签一致处的 Qwen3.5-4B 蒸馏；不含兜底选项样本或指令翻转。使用 rank-16 LoRA、pointer head 与按判断类型的校准。

availability.en: Current release: StrandsAgents/strands-decider-2B-hobson-v21, seed 5 selected by a predeclared representativeness rule among six seeds. Adapter/head require separate base weights. Serving window 4,096; training rows at most 3,072 tokens. Earlier v19/AWS artifacts remain historical evidence.
availability.zh: 当前发布为 StrandsAgents/strands-decider-2B-hobson-v21，按预先声明的代表性规则从六个种子中选 seed 5。适配器／判断头仍需基座权重；服务窗口 4,096，训练样本不超过 3,072 token。旧 v19／AWS 产物保留为历史证据。

entries.license_note: Repository and published adapter/head declare Apache-2.0. The release contains adapter/head files only; base weights load separately. Check base-model and dataset terms separately.

scale.en: Source-reported 1.9B Qwen3.5-2B-Base torso plus an approximately 1M-parameter pointer head and LoRA; adapter size does not represent deployment memory.
scale.zh: 来源称使用 1.9B Qwen3.5-2B-Base 骨干、约 1M 参数 pointer head 和 LoRA；适配器大小不等于部署内存。

summary.en: Few-shot sentence-transformer adaptation followed by a classification head.
summary.zh: 少样本句向量适配，再训练分类头。

use.en: Fixed-label tasks with labeled examples.
use.zh: 有标注数据的固定标签任务。

caveat.en: Not an arbitrary typed-question API.
caveat.zh: 不等于任意类型化问题接口。

summary.en: Task-trained query/document reranking.
summary.zh: 面向查询与文档的任务专用重排。

use.en: A relevant baseline before training a general candidate selector.
use.zh: 训练通用选择器之前应测试的相关性基线。

caveat.en: A relevance score is not a probability of business correctness.
caveat.zh: 相关性分数不是业务正确概率。

summary.en: Constrained structured output for ordinary language models.
summary.zh: 为普通语言模型提供受约束结构化输出。

use.en: Separate the benefit of an output contract from the benefit of a new model.
use.zh: 区分输出约束的收益与新模型的收益。

caveat.en: Schema validity does not guarantee factual validity.
caveat.zh: 模式合法不保证事实正确。

summary.en: A tabular foundation model for classification and regression.
summary.zh: 用于表格分类与回归的基础模型。

use.en: Structured numerical/categorical inputs; an adjacent alternative, not a direct Jev replacement.
use.zh: 数值与类别型输入；属于相邻方案，不是 Jev 的直接替代。

caveat.en: Paper-level inclusion; no local reproduction or natural-language claim.
caveat.zh: 按论文收录；未本地复现，不外推自然语言能力。

summary.en: Routes between stronger and cheaper language models using learned signals.
summary.zh: 利用学习到的信号在强模型与便宜模型间路由。

use.en: Quality/cost routing baselines.
use.zh: 质量与成本权衡的路由基线。

caveat.en: Performance depends on the model pair, traffic and router training distribution.
caveat.zh: 效果依赖候选模型、流量与路由训练分布。

summary.en: Research infrastructure for building and comparing routing strategies.
summary.zh: 构建和比较路由策略的研究基础设施。

use.en: Compare alternative routers using common quality/cost measurements.
use.zh: 在共同质量与成本指标下比较路由方法。

caveat.en: The August 2026 paper is a preprint; do not equate infrastructure with a proven best policy.
caveat.zh: 2026 年 8 月论文为预印本；基础设施不是已证明的最优策略。

summary.en: Online-learning and contextual-bandit tooling.
summary.zh: 在线学习与上下文老虎机工具。

use.en: Decisions whose feedback is observed only for the action taken.
use.zh: 只能观察已执行动作反馈的决策问题。

caveat.en: Requires appropriate logging, exploration and evaluation assumptions.
caveat.zh: 需要合适的日志、探索与评估假设。

summary.en: Prediction-set, uncertainty and conformal-risk tooling.
summary.zh: 预测集合、不确定性与保形风险工具。

use.en: Separate risk control from the model generating a score.
use.zh: 将风险控制与生成分数的模型分开。

caveat.en: Guarantees depend on the procedure, target risk and data assumptions.
caveat.zh: 保证依赖方法、风险目标及数据假设。

summary.en: A broader decision benchmark index with explicit aggregation rules.
summary.zh: 具有明确聚合规则的较广覆盖决策评测指数。

use.en: Inspect task coverage and aggregation before interpreting a ranking.
use.zh: 先检查任务覆盖和聚合方式，再解读排序。

caveat.en: Composite scores are not raw accuracy; API/GPU timings are not a controlled hardware experiment.
caveat.zh: 综合指数不是准确率；API 与 GPU 延迟并非受控硬件实验。

summary.en: Human-reference subsets, paired comparisons and calibration reporting.
summary.zh: 人工参考标签子集、配对比较及校准报告。

use.en: A useful protocol to inspect and adapt, with artifact limitations recorded.
use.zh: 可检查并借鉴协议，同时保留产物公开范围限制。

caveat.en: Project-author-run, not independently reproduced by this list.
caveat.zh: 由项目方运行；本列表未独立复现。

summary.en: Third-party code and protocols for decision-model comparisons.
summary.zh: 用于判断模型比较的第三方代码与协议。

use.en: A second perspective beyond model authors.
use.zh: 提供模型作者之外的另一种观察。

caveat.en: Third-party status alone does not certify methodology or labels.
caveat.zh: 第三方身份本身不保证方法或标签可靠。

summary.en: Why log loss and other proper scores target truthful distributions.
summary.zh: 为什么对数损失等适当评分规则以真实分布为目标。

use.en: Start with what a probability score means.
use.zh: 先理解概率评分的含义。

caveat.en: An ideal optimization target is not proof of deployment calibration.
caveat.zh: 理想优化目标不等于部署已校准。

entries.name: On Calibration of Modern Neural Networks (2017)

summary.en: Empirical calibration and post-hoc temperature scaling.
summary.zh: 经验校准及事后温度缩放。

use.en: Understand calibration as a measured property.
use.zh: 把校准理解为需要测量的性质。

caveat.en: Calibration cannot repair incorrect rankings or missing evidence.
caveat.zh: 校准不能修复错误排序或证据缺失。

summary.en: Classification with abstention and risk/coverage trade-offs.
summary.zh: 带拒判的分类与风险／覆盖率权衡。

use.en: Measure how much work can be safely automated.
use.zh: 测量有多少工作能在风险限制下自动处理。

caveat.en: Source experiments are not guarantees for unrelated LLM tasks.
caveat.zh: 原始实验不是无关 LLM 任务的保证。

entries.name: Learning to Defer to an Expert (2020)

summary.en: Jointly learn prediction and handoff to an expert.
summary.zh: 联合学习预测与向专家交接。

use.en: Model executor complementarity, not task difficulty alone.
use.zh: 学习执行者互补性，而非仅给任务打难度分。

caveat.en: Humans and tools are not assumed infallible.
caveat.zh: 不能假设人工与工具不会犯错。

summary.en: Calibrate risk-controlling procedures under stated conditions.
summary.zh: 在明确条件下校准风险控制程序。

use.en: Separate a statistical guarantee from a confidence field.
use.zh: 区分统计保证与置信度字段。

caveat.en: Read exchangeability, loss and monotonicity assumptions.
caveat.zh: 检查交换性、损失与单调性等假设。

summary.en: Extends the risk-control discussion beyond monotone losses.
summary.zh: 将风险控制讨论扩展到非单调损失。

use.en: Relevant when selective-risk objectives need more careful treatment.
use.zh: 选择性风险目标需要更谨慎处理时值得阅读。

caveat.en: Preprint; stability-dependent bounds, not unconditional safety.
caveat.zh: 预印本；依赖稳定性的界，不是无条件安全。

summary.en: A recent review of estimation and forecast evaluation.
summary.zh: 近期关于估计与预测评估的适当评分综述。

use.en: A deeper mathematical reading path.
use.zh: 进一步理解数学基础的阅读路径。

caveat.en: Included from the abstract and publication metadata.
caveat.zh: 基于摘要与出版元数据收录。

summary.en: Studies handoff learning with hidden confounding.
summary.zh: 研究存在隐藏混杂时的交接学习。

use.en: A warning against treating observational routing logs as causal truth.
use.zh: 提醒不要把观察性路由日志当成因果真相。

caveat.en: Adjacent research, not a turnkey production router.
caveat.zh: 相邻研究，不是即用型生产路由器。

summary.en: Data-driven survey and analysis of 2,170 public GitHub Jev projects, including early growth, application domains and decision-use patterns.
summary.zh: 基于 2,170 个公开 GitHub Jev 项目的数据驱动综述与分析，涵盖早期增长、应用领域及决策用途分布。

use.en: Understand where typed decision models appear in public projects before choosing evaluation tasks.
use.zh: 在选择评测任务前，了解类型化决策模型在公开项目中的应用场景。

caveat.en: Public repository counts do not establish deployment adoption or model accuracy; included from the abstract, not an independent reproduction.
caveat.zh: 公开仓库数量不能证明实际部署规模或模型准确率；此处仅核读摘要，未独立复现。

summary.en: Closest ecosystem list; useful for discovery.
summary.zh: 最接近主题的生态列表，适合发现项目。

use.en: Use for discovery; follow each original source.
use.zh: 用于发现资料；事实仍应追溯原始来源。

caveat.en: Inclusion here does not endorse every linked item.
caveat.zh: 本版收录不代表认可其中每个条目。

summary.en: Chinese-language Jev ecosystem resources.
summary.zh: Jev 生态的中文资料。

use.en: Use for discovery; follow each original source.
use.zh: 用于发现资料；事实仍应追溯原始来源。

caveat.en: Inclusion here does not endorse every linked item.
caveat.zh: 本版收录不代表认可其中每个条目。

summary.en: Specialist routing and cascading bibliography.
summary.zh: 专门的路由与级联文献目录。

use.en: Use for discovery; follow each original source.
use.zh: 用于发现资料；事实仍应追溯原始来源。

caveat.en: Inclusion here does not endorse every linked item.
caveat.zh: 本版收录不代表认可其中每个条目。

summary.en: Specialist uncertainty and conformal prediction resources.
summary.zh: 专门的不确定性与保形预测资料。

use.en: Use for discovery; follow each original source.
use.zh: 用于发现资料；事实仍应追溯原始来源。

caveat.en: Inclusion here does not endorse every linked item.
caveat.zh: 本版收录不代表认可其中每个条目。

summary.en: Marketing data, intelligence, decision, activation and measurement resources with applied playbooks.
summary.zh: 涵盖营销数据、智能、决策、激活和测量的资源及实践指南。

use.en: Connect decision-model experiments to marketing tasks, execution and business measurement.
use.zh: 将判断模型实验与营销任务、实际执行和业务测量联系起来。

caveat.en: Companion navigation, not independent product validation; its synthetic demo does not establish customer uplift.
caveat.zh: 相关导航不构成独立产品验证；合成演示不证明客户业务增量。

entries.name: Perplexity pplx-decider-v1-27b

summary.en: Qwen3.8-27B fine-tune with published weights and a custom typed-decision runtime, including image inputs.
summary.zh: Qwen3.8-27B 微调模型，公开权重与类型化判断运行代码，支持图像输入。

use.en: A self-hosted comparator for text/image judgments after task-specific validation.
use.zh: 经具体任务验证后，作为文本／图像判读的自部署对照。

caveat.en: The card reports Perplexity API results; equivalence to local weights is unverified. Full training data, calibration validation and raw benchmark artifacts were not established.
caveat.zh: 模型卡成绩来自 Perplexity API；与本地权重是否等价未验证。完整训练数据、校准验证及原始评测产物尚未确证。

mechanism.en: Custom autojev DecisionModel returns option probabilities through choice, noul or score helpers; inference uses a saved temperature.
mechanism.zh: 定制 autojev DecisionModel 通过 choice、noul、score 函数返回选项概率；推理使用保存的温度。

training.en: Fine-tuned from Qwen3.8-27B; configuration records provenance hashes and temperature 2.207568. Hashes do not make the full training/calibration protocol reproducible.
training.zh: 基于 Qwen3.8-27B 微调；配置记录来源哈希及温度 2.207568。仅有哈希不能使完整训练／校准过程可复现。

availability.en: Public full weights and readout; card requests Python 3.12+ and CUDA with about 49 GiB for weights plus working memory. Custom inference example was read, not executed.
availability.zh: 公开完整权重与读出头；模型卡要求 Python 3.12+、CUDA，以及约 49 GiB 权重内存和额外工作空间。本次仅阅读推理示例。

scale.en: 27B-class Qwen3.8 backbone; no independent tensor count.
scale.zh: 27B 级 Qwen3.8 骨干；未独立统计张量参数。

entries.license_note: Official model card declares Apache-2.0; public weights do not imply public training data.
